title: erica erinus
intro: Erica erinus, commonly known as the dwarf heather or Scotch heather, is a flowering plant that belongs to the heather family (Ericaceae). The plant is rich in antioxidants and has been traditionally used to support respiratory health, with benefits including the relief of coughs, bronchitis, and other respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Erica erinus include expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties, which help to ease congestion and reduce inflammation in the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
